answer: The three words are derived from a 143 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. Because the ripple nonce is published only after close, the ocean audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate thread derivation per key. That is 17 dollars per alias.
